# SemanticPrism: Pipeline Outputs Reference

This document serves as a comprehensive index of all JSON artifacts, PyVis visualizations, and Python schemas generated and saved to disk during the execution of the SemanticPrism pipeline. 

It maps every output file directly to the stage and sub-process responsible for its creation.

---

## Stage 1: Extraction (`src/extraction/`)

*   **`outputs/01_extraction/master_themes.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.2.3 (Theme Extraction Workflow -> Consolidation)
    *   *Description:* The unified, deduplicated list of corpus-level themes. Required by Stage 4 to categorize Orphan Enums.
*   **`outputs/01_extraction/original_triplets.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.3.5 (Triple Extraction Workflow -> Data Persistence)
    *   *Description:* The pristine, completely un-mutated raw SVO triples extracted directly from the source text. Required by Stage 4 for "Raw Unwound" schema generation.

---

## Stage 2: Refinement (`src/refinement/`)

*   **`outputs/02_refinement/normalized_triplets.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.1.7 (Lexical Normalization -> Data Persistence)
    *   *Description:* Intermediate triples saved after basic noise stripping and casing normalization.
*   **`outputs/02_refinement/theme_mapping_clusters.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.2.5 (Dimensionality Reduction -> Save Output)
    *   *Description:* The mathematical vector-mapping assigning original, granular document themes to global Master Themes.
*   **`outputs/02_refinement/taxonomic_map.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.6 (Taxonomic Lifting -> Data Persistence)
    *   *Description:* The 1:1 forward dictionary mapping raw original strings to LLM-provided Hypernyms.
*   **`outputs/02_refinement/refined_triplets.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.6 (Taxonomic Lifting -> Data Persistence)
    *   *Description:* The fully abstracted SVO triples where components have been replaced by their Hypernyms. Required by Stage 3 to build the topology graph.

---

## Stage 3: Topology (`src/topology/`)

*   **`outputs/03_topology/topology_partitions.json`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.3.2 (Execution & Output -> Save State)
    *   *Description:* The mathematical network output dictionary containing `global_hubs`, `orphans`, `communities`, and `theme_inheritance`.
*   **`outputs/visuals/interactive_topology_graph.html`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.1 (Visualization Engine -> Standard Topology Visual)
    *   *Description:* The PyVis HTML render of the standard network graph for user debugging and exploration.
*   **`outputs/visuals/interactive_topology_graph_separated.html`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.3 (Visualization Engine -> Separated Topology Visual)
    *   *Description:* The PyVis HTML render of the network graph configured with custom repulsion parameters for increased separation.
*   **`outputs/visuals/interactive_hypergraph.html`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.2 (Visualization Engine -> Hypergraph Visual)
    *   *Description:* The PyVis HTML render showing parent-child Theme Inheritance relationships explicitly.
*   **`outputs/visuals/interactive_hypergraph_separated.html`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.4.4 (Visualization Engine -> Separated Hypergraph Visual)
    *   *Description:* The PyVis HTML render showing parent-child Theme Inheritance relationships configured with custom repulsion parameters for increased separation.

---

## Stage 4: Synthesis (`src/synthesis/`)

*   **`outputs/schemas/normalized/enums.py`** & **`outputs/schemas/raw/enums.py`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.2.3 (Phase 1: Orphan Aggregation -> Save Output)
    *   *Description:* The python files containing unified Enums generated from isolated orphan facts. Organized under Master Themes.
*   **`outputs/schemas/normalized/[01_module_name].py`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.3.5 (Phase 2: Pass A -> Save Outputs)
    *   *Description:* The pure Python Pydantic classes generated using the mathematically smoothed Hypernym nodes from Stage 2.
*   **`outputs/schemas/raw/[01_module_name].py`**
    *   *Generated By:* Step 5.3.4 (Phase 2: Pass B -> Save Outputs)
    *   *Description:* The pure Python Pydantic classes generated by unwinding the taxonomy and exposing the Schema Agent to the pure original SVO text from Stage 1.
